title: 信息日报 2026-11-04

headline.title: 民主党在2026年美国中期选举中赢得参议院控制权
headline.summary: 民主党翻转参议院，被广泛视为对特朗普所属共和党的否定；共和党曾在2024年赢得该院控制权。
headline.title_en: Democratic Party wins US Senate in 2026 midterm elections
headline.summary_en: Democrats flipped the U.S. Senate in the 2026 midterms, a result widely seen as a rebuke to Trump's Republican Party, which won the chamber in 2024.
headline.original_title: Democratic Party wins US Senate in 2026 midterm elections
headline.reason: 美国中期选举参议院归属是国会权力格局的关键结果。
headline.reason_en: Control of the U.S. Senate is a key outcome shaping congressional power after the midterms.
